findings.expected: The dossier promises a tapir of light that advances along ground and is evaded by jumping. Either summon should remain at the ground plane y512 or airborne invocation should be explicitly gated; it should not create a grounded-target-only projectile suspended above them.
findings.actionableFix: Resolved by central requiresGround start/emission gate. No outstanding fix requested.
findings.observedBeforeFix: At relative tick21 (absolute531), caster y405.32 and grounded=false; projectile groundOnly=true,y365.2,vx±6. It remains horizontal at that elevated height, cannot hit airborne targets because groundOnly requires target.grounded, and cannot reach grounded Javier at y554. Rival remainsHP100, Lionza hits0, shot eventually expires.
findings.resolvedBehavior: Technique.requiresGround=true only for wildspirit. beginAttack rejects airborne special before spending25 energy; updateAttack suppresses projectile emission if caster airborne at active frame. Verified both sides in12-test final fresh run.
